sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0344: part BR-310; plant TO2; customer CLM; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-5083-H111; status APPROVED 2025-06-11 (PPAP-2025-052)
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Approval is granted per part, per receiving plant and per customer, never per supplier.
Proposed change, as said in the meeting: Run BR-310 for Cantieri Lombardi at Plant 1 using Meccanica C billet, the Plant 2 line is down.

findings.why: The only approval for BR-310 with Meccanica C is for plant TO2 and customer CLM. The ASL is the complete controlled list for TO1 and TO2, and it has no entry for BR-310 at TO1. Approval is per part, receiving plant and customer, so Meccanica C has no current approval for BR-310 at Plant 1. A temporary deviation would not fix this, because PRC-DEV-007 says it does not approve a new material source.
